text: Your miners struck a seam of silver in the hills

subject: Nation
text: Wandering scholars shared their learning with your Nation

name: Settlers
subject: Nation
text: Settlers from distant lands made their home in your Nation

name: Library fire
subject: Nation
text: Fire took the scrolls of your library

name: Dust storm
subject: Warparty
text: A dust storm swept the plains

name: Swollen river
subject: Warparty
text: A swollen river forced a long way round

name: Local guides
subject: Warparty
text: Local guides showed the way through the hills

name: Rumours of war
subject: Nation
text: Rumours spread of a large army marching on your Nation

name: Outbreak
subject: Nation
text: Sickness broke out in your Nation

outcomes.text: You quarantined the sick
You quarantined the sick, but the sickness slipped past the guards
Your healers spent their learning on the sick
Your healers spent their learning on the sick and found a cure
You let the sickness spread
You let the sickness spread, but it soon burned itself out
You paid the bandits to move on
You paid the bandits, and they came back for more
Your people hunted the bandits down
The bandits ambushed your hunters
Your people hunted the bandits down and seized their loot
You ignored the bandits and they plundered freely
You ignored the bandits, and they moved on to richer lands

name: Travelling merchants
subject: Nation
text: Travelling merchants offer you books from distant lands

outcomes.text: You bought the merchants' books
You bought the merchants' books, but most were forgeries
You turned the merchants away
You turned the merchants away, but a scholar among them stayed to teach

name: Refugees
subject: Nation
text: Refugees fleeing war have gathered at your border

outcomes.text: You fed and housed the refugees
You fed and housed the refugees, but most moved on before winter
You closed the border to the refugees
You closed the border, but some refugees slipped across and settled

name: Flood
subject: Nation
text: Heavy rains have the rivers rising

outcomes.text: You raised levees against the flood
You raised levees, but the river broke through them
You evacuated the lowlands, though some were lost
You evacuated the lowlands in time, and no one was lost
You hoped the flood would pass, and it swept the lowlands away
You hoped the flood would pass, and the rains stopped just in time

name: Tax revolt
subject: Nation
text: Your people are protesting against your taxes

outcomes.text: You lowered taxes
You lowered taxes, but the protesters demanded more
You crushed the revolt
You tried to crush the revolt, and it spread to your cities
You ignored the protests and riots broke out
You ignored the protests, and they died down on their own

name: Crumbling Buildings
subject: Nation
text: Your engineers warn that your defensive Buildings are crumbling

outcomes.text: You paid the masons to shore up your defensive Buildings
You paid the masons, but their work was shoddy
You left your defensive Buildings to crumble
You left your defensive Buildings be, and they held for now
